card.name: Warning section headings and their first words
card.fires_on: Words that start or sit inside a warning or precaution heading or its first sentence, such as a section title in a drug label. It also fires on the word right after a heading, such as the first word of a new risk statement.

modes.label: Inside warning headings
modes.description: Partway through a heading naming a risk or condition, often a numbered section title.

modes.label: Start of text after a heading
modes.description: The first word or linking word of the sentence right after a heading or topic phrase.

modes.label: Inside risk phrases
modes.description: Small linking words or punctuation within a risk statement, such as 'of' after a noun.
modes.example: 5.4 Risk<< of>> Adverse Reactions or Loss of V
